    How to play

    Each game starts after 4–6 moves per side have already been played. The shaded entries in the move list show how the board got there.

    Pick a piece and then its destination. You can also drag a piece. Use the arrow keys to navigate the board and Enter to select a square.

    Stockfish checks the opening positions for a small advantage at most and several viable continuations. Finish the game to replay the same opening with the colors swapped.
